Implemented the CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with supporting logic in [output/lib.js](/workspace/output/lib.js) and an executable wrapper at [output/ical](/workspace/output/ical).

It supports:
- `ical parse --input <path.ics> --output <out.json>`
- `ical expand --input <path.ics> --from <ISO-8601> --to <ISO-8601> --output <out.json>`

The implementation includes:
- RFC-style content-line parsing with unfolding, parameter decoding, TEXT unescaping, structured warnings, and positional parse errors
- Typed projection for `VEVENT`, `VTODO`, `VJOURNAL`, `VFREEBUSY`, `VTIMEZONE`, `VALARM`, and `VAVAILABILITY`/`AVAILABLE`
- RRULE/RDATE/EXDATE/EXRULE handling, `RECURRENCE-ID` overrides including `RANGE=THISANDFUTURE`
- in-file `VTIMEZONE` resolution for zoned expansion output, including fold/gap warning behavior
- iTIP `METHOD` validation warnings

Verification:
- `node --check /workspace/output/lib.js`
- `node --check /workspace/output/main.js`
- smoke-tested `parse` and `expand` on UTC-recurring and custom-`VTIMEZONE` samples successfully

    def test_range_thisandfuture_replaces_future(
        submission_command: tuple[str, ...], tmp_path: Path

        # Daily at 10:00, COUNT=5. On 2026-03-07, apply THISANDFUTURE to move to 15:00.

            "BEGIN:VEVENT\n"
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\nDTSTART:20260305T100000Z\n"
            "RRULE:FREQ=DAILY;COUNT=5\nEND:VEVENT\n"
            "BEGIN:VEVENT\n"
            "UID:e1\nDTSTAMP:20260101T120000Z\n"
            "RECURRENCE-ID;RANGE=THISANDFUTURE:20260307T100000Z\n"
            "DTSTART:20260307T150000Z\n"
